_comment: Political intrigue: secrets for sale, officials at odds, favours called in, schemes against you, the Nassau council. See docs/events.md and data/politics.json.

clerk_sells_secret.title: A clerk with something to sell
clerk_sells_secret.text: A clerk from the governor's house finds you in a tavern. He has papers concerning {target}, and debts to pay.

choices.result: Genuine, as far as you can tell.
{target} thanks you warmly. The clerk is not seen again.
He finds another buyer.

officials_feud.title: A quarrel in high places
officials_feud.text: {a} and {b} are at daggers drawn over who controls the town's trade, and each wants you on their side.

choices.result: {a} owes you. {b} will remember.
{b} owes you. {a} will remember.
Both think you're on their side. For now.
choices.fail_result: They compare notes. Neither trusts you now.

choices.result: Wise, perhaps.

favour_called_in.title: {creditor} calls in a favour
favour_called_in.text: A letter from {creditor}: you owe a favour, and now it's wanted. A {nation_adj} merchantman, a friend's ship by the sound of it, is to be taken and her papers sent on.

choices.result: A debt is a debt.
{creditor} takes it, with ill grace.
You've made an enemy, and you still owe the favour.

favour_called_in_crew.title: {creditor} needs hands
favour_called_in_crew.text: {creditor} sends word: they need your crew for a few days' work no one is to ask about. You owe them.

choices.result: Three days of moving crates by night. The men grumble; the debt is paid.
{creditor} doesn't forget.

scheme_turn_officer.title: Your officer and a stranger
scheme_turn_officer.text: {informant} has seen {officer} drinking with one of {enemy}'s men, three nights running. Money changed hands.

choices.result: {officer} confesses everything: {enemy} wanted your plans and your course. They're yours again.
choices.fail_result: {officer} slips ashore that night, and takes the ship's purse.

choices.result: {enemy} acts on your lies and is made a fool of, and you learn how they pay their spies.
choices.fail_result: {officer} sees through it and goes over to {enemy} for good.

choices.result: Better safe.

scheme_bribe_crew.title: Silver in the forecastle
scheme_bribe_crew.text: Spanish silver keeps turning up in the crew's dice games, and nobody aboard has been paid in silver. Someone, perhaps {enemy}, is buying your men.

choices.result: It leads back to {enemy}. You have proof now, and the plot is broken.
choices.fail_result: The trail goes cold, and the men who took the money keep it, and their new loyalties.

choices.result: Resented, but it slows the rot.
The money keeps coming.

scheme_frame.title: Your name on the handbills
scheme_frame.text: Handbills on every quay accuse you of crimes you never committed: a burned village, a murdered crew. The style of the printing points to {enemy}.

choices.result: The printer talks. You have {enemy}'s receipts, and a weapon of your own.
choices.fail_result: The printer is gone. The lies stick.

choices.text: Pay to have them torn down
choices.result: Most of them come down. Some of the mud sticks.

choices.text: Let them say what they like
choices.result: Your name grows. Not in a good way.

scheme_false_tip.title: A tip too good to be true
scheme_false_tip.text: A stranger, generous with the rum, tells you the course of a rich ship from {port}. He seems to want very much for you to go.

choices.result: You'll be waiting on her course in a few days.
{enemy}. It was a trap. You thank him, and don't go.
If it sounds too good...

ambush_trap.title: The trap closes
ambush_trap.text: No rich merchantman: a {nation_adj} warship, cleared for action, waiting just where the stranger said your prize would be.

choices.result: So be it.
Every sail you have.

assassin.title: A knife in the dark
assassin.text: A man with a knife is waiting in the alley behind the tavern. He doesn't want your purse. Somebody, {enemy} most likely, wants you dead.

choices.result: He runs, bleeding. A message for {enemy}.
choices.fail_result: You drive him off, but not before he marks you.

choices.result: You make it, and post a guard on the gangway.
choices.fail_result: He catches you on the quay.

exile_passage.title: An exile
exile_passage.text: {exile}, a disgraced official with a price on their head, begs passage to {dest}, where friends are waiting. The governor here would pay well to have them back.

choices.result: You get {exile} aboard under the nose of the harbour watch.
choices.fail_result: You're seen. The governor will remember this.

choices.result: The reward is generous. {exile} is led away in chains.
Not your trouble.

exile_arrives.title: Safe in {dest}
exile_arrives.text: {exile} steps ashore in {dest}, among friends at last, and presses something into your hand: copies of their enemy's private letters.

choices.result: A dangerous gift.

schedule_prize.title: Right on schedule
schedule_prize.text: There she is: the ship from the sailing schedule, low in the water, exactly where the papers said she'd be.

choices.result: Out of the sun, as planned.
Not today.

council_invitation.title: A seat at the council
council_invitation.text: In the ruined fort above Nassau harbour, the captains of the council are drinking. One of them waves you over: your name is known now, and there's a seat for you if you want it.

choices.result: You sit with the Brethren's captains now. Votes, favours, and enemies come with it.
The offer stands, for now.

council_pardon_debate.title: The council and the pardon
council_pardon_debate.text: The King's Pardon splits the council. {speaker} wants every captain to take it while it's offered; others would rather hang.

choices.result: The vote is taken.
The vote is taken.

council_code_breaker.title: A breach of the code
council_code_breaker.text: {accused} marooned a shipmate over a share of plunder, and the council must decide whether the code was broken.

choices.result: The vote is taken.
The vote is taken. {accused} won't forget you stood up for them.

council_defence.title: The Crown is coming
council_defence.text: Word from the Carolinas: the Crown means to take Nassau back. The council must decide whether to fight for the haven or scatter.

choices.result: The vote is taken.
The vote is taken.
